qa_pair.question: A requirement for an IFC4 model says that load-bearing walls must be marked as such. Which data type does the IFC standard give the property that marks a wall as load-bearing? Answer with the name of the IFC data type.
In IFC4 the quantity set of the standard for building storeys has a quantity for the net height of the storey. What is its exact name in the standard, letter for letter?
How many predefined types can a rule select for IfcSlab in IFC4, counting USERDEFINED and NOTDEFINED? Answer with a number.
An IDS file is to be written for IFC2X3. Can a rule there select walls by a predefined type? Answer Yes or No.
In IFC4, how many property sets of the standard have a property named AcousticRating? Answer with a number.
In a Bimlint file for IFC4 the line "for IfcWall" selects walls together with their subtypes. How many class names does the compiled IDS file list for it? Answer with a number.
Someone wrote this rule for IFC4: for IfcDoor, require attribute OverallHeight >= 2.1 (a number without anything after it). Which diagnostic code does the checker answer with?

Write a rule for IFC4 that requires the thermal transmittance of walls to be at most 0.24 W/m²K, with the property of the IFC standard. Compile it and report the value of the dataType attribute that the IDS file gives the property, exactly as the file writes it.

A requirement says that walls must state whether they are accessible for the handicapped, with the property HandicapAccessible of the IFC4 standard. Which property set of the standard can a rule for IfcWall require for it? Answer with the name of the set, or None when there is none.
According to the language guide, which keyword makes a rule select exactly the named class, without its subtypes? Answer with the keyword alone.
